# netskope_aig_appliance_capacity_list (Data Source)

Read-only data source listing API call capacity usage per AIG appliance in the current billing period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_appliance_capacity_list" "my_aigappliancecapacitylist" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `elements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements))

<a id="nestedatt--elements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (String) End of the current billing period.
- `id` (String) Appliance ID.
- `metrics` (Attributes List) Capacity metrics for this appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--metrics))
- `name` (String) Appliance name.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the current billing period.

<a id="nestedatt--elements--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.metrics`

Read-Only:

- `entitled` (Number) Total API calls entitled this billing period.
- `is_throttled` (Boolean) Whether the appliance is currently throttled due to overuse.
- `name` (String) Metric name.
- `passthrough` (Number) Number of API calls bypassed due to throttling.
- `unit` (String) Billing unit.
- `usage` (Number) Number of API calls used while active.
